quote.text: It is better that ten guilty persons escape than that one innocent suffer.
quote.author: William Blackstone, Commentaries on the Laws of England, Book IV (1769)

stories.kicker: Technology · The Banks Police The Chip Rule
stories.headline: Citigroup and DBS vet data-centre clients over chip rule
stories.dek: Bloomberg reported on 25 November that Citigroup, Standard Chartered, DBS, OCBC and UOB are asking Southeast Asian data-centre clients who uses their American AI chips.

stories.kicker: The Macro Desk · Prices Up, Spending Flat
stories.headline: Core inflation in America hits 3.3%, highest since January 2024
stories.dek: The Commerce Department’s October figures, out on 25 November, showed spending after inflation slipping as third-quarter growth was revised up to 4.3 per cent.

stories.kicker: The Undercurrent · Nepal: The AI Detector On Trial
stories.headline: Nepal’s Supreme Court makes Tribhuvan University defend AI detector
stories.dek: Six Tribhuvan University law students won a show-cause order on 25 November; on 30 November a judge weighs whether to halt rejections based on a software score alone.

stories.kicker: The World · Yemen’s Houthis And Saudi Arabia
stories.headline: Houthi drone hits Riyadh’s tallest tower, wounding 11
stories.dek: The 24 November strike on the Public Investment Fund tower came five days after a missile damaged it; on 25 November Saudi Arabia downed four drones over its Ras Tanura refinery.

stories.headline: METI lifts Singapore’s 2026 growth forecast to six per cent
stories.dek: METI revised Singapore’s third-quarter growth to 6.1 per cent from an advance 5.4 on 24 November and pencilled in 2.5 to 4.5 per cent for 2027.

stories.headline: Sweden’s Ankarsrum tops America’s Test Kitchen stand mixer test
stories.dek: The motor-in-the-base Assistent Original, sold since 1940, won ATK’s 1 October 2026 review of 16 machines; Metro Singapore lists it at S$1,799 against S$699 for a KitchenAid Artisan.

stories.headline: Coros’s Vertix 4 adds a built-in torch for US$799
stories.dek: Announced on 24 November, the adventure watch goes on sale on Black Friday, 27 November, at US$100 more than the Vertix 2S it replaces, with no Singapore price yet.

stories.kicker: The Good Life · Blancpain Carrousel Incliné
stories.headline: Blancpain tilts its carrousel 30 degrees for CHF380,000
stories.dek: The Carrousel Incliné, shown on 24 November with a choice of two gold movements, is the first Blancpain whose whole case is cut from sapphire crystal.

stories.headline: Peter Gabriel releases o\i, his longest album, on Friday
stories.dek: Peter Gabriel’s 13-song companion to 2023’s i/o runs about 80 minutes in each of its two mixes and lands on 27 November, after twelve of its songs came out one per full moon.

stories.kicker: Raising Them Well · Heartbeats And Body Image
stories.headline: Heartbeat-aware girls report less body dissatisfaction, Kent study finds
stories.dek: Mariana Von Mohr’s team tested 181 English schoolgirls aged 10 to 14 in their classrooms; the link was clearest in girls further through puberty, and it is a snapshot, not proof of cause.

stories.headline: TeaDB tells pu-erh newcomers to start under US$50
stories.dek: James of TeaDB, in a guide posted on 4 November, steers beginners to factory-made ripe cakes and quick steeps in boiling water; Yunnan Sourcing sells a starter gaiwan for US$7.25.

stories.headline: Split walks steady blood sugar better in Colorado trial
stories.dek: Audrey Bergouignan’s team gave 30 sedentary adults 45 minutes of brisk walking a day, five days a week for six weeks; those who walked it in five-minute bouts held steadier glucose than those who walked it at once.

stories.kicker: The Diary · Studio Ghibli, Genji And Bon Jovi
stories.headline: Studio Ghibli exhibition lands at Gardens by the Bay
stories.dek: Twelve recreated film worlds open on 18 December at S$29–55; in Ueno, Tokyo, the Kyoto-born Tale of Genji exhibition opens on 19 January.
